name: MCP Tools Remote Server
description: Exposes the MCP Tools server over HTTP at /_mcp_tools with API-key authentication, IP/Origin allowlists, per-key scopes and a configured execution user; intended for trusted internal networks.
project_description: Sub-module of MCP Tools. Serves the MCP protocol over HTTP (MCP Streamable HTTP transport) at /_mcp_tools. Disabled by default; requires a configured execution user and a hashed, peppered API key. Ships drush commands to create/list/revoke keys and to provision a dedicated least-privilege executor account.
